title: Approximate weak equation on the graph part of the varifold (Simon 4.5 (8)-(12))
statement: Let n >= 1, l, U an open subset of R^{n+l}, V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with generalized mean curvature H in U, with x |-> p_x = V.tangentProj x mu-a.e. strongly measurable (mu = V.weight), sigma > 0 with B_sigma(0) contained in U, q a linear isometry, T = rotatedPlane q, P = T.starProjection, and f : R^n -> R^l 1-Lipschitz on B^n_{sigma/2}(0) with |f| <= sigma/16 there. Assume dist(x, T) <= sigma/16 for x in spt V cap B_sigma(0), and that for mu-a.e. x, whenever x = q(graphPoint x' (f x')) with |x'| < sigma/2 and f differentiable at x', p_x is the orthogonal projection onto span{q(graphPoint v (Df(x') v))}. Let zeta : R^n -> R be C^1 with compact support, tsupport zeta contained in B°^n_{sigma/4}(0), |grad zeta| <= M, j in Fin l, a(x) := (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q^{-1}x)).1, Gamma := q(graph f over B^n_{sigma/2}(0)) and Gamma' := q(graph f over B°^n_{sigma/4}(0)). Then |int_{Gamma'} <grad f^j(a(x)), grad zeta(a(x))> dmu| <= M mu(B_{sigma/2}(0) cap (spt V \ Gamma)) + M int_{B_sigma(0)} |p_x - P|^2 dmu + M (sigma/4) int_{B_{sigma/2}(0)} |H| dmu, where f^j = (f .)_j, |.|^2 = hsNormSq, the integrals are Bochner integrals, and the first term is M times (mu(B_{sigma/2}(0) cap (spt V \ Gamma))).toReal; under these hypotheses this measure is at most mu(B_sigma(0)), which is finite because B_sigma(0) is a compact subset of U, so toReal loses nothing.
